subject: interim E4 done; real E4 still blocked
body: Interim E4 dry run (demo researchers, claude-cli, NOT the real E4) is in results/e4_interim/ (59bcb72): 4 arms x 3 seeds plus held-out eval on the 3 other built-in scenarios, 312 E4b packets, about $36. Held-out delta mean over seeds: R0 +0.026, R1-demo_realist -0.107, R1-demo_realist-prompt -0.064, R1-bad -0.004. The large losses are designs with metric-inflation-specific content that do not transfer. Descriptive only. The demo user models are consulted only at D1. Real E4 (results/prereg/E4.json, 5daf3e0): C2 models.json and C1 items/split resolved and wired into scripts/e4_commands.py. Still blocked on: C1 calibration gate, WS B tracks.json + usermodel.json for P and S, [decide] web on/off, [decide] placebo arms, user approval. Deadline: claude-sonnet-4-5 (held-out target) retires 2026-11-30.
